propositions: SupportsIncremental is a @runtime_checkable Protocol with zero implementers and zero callers in the codebase (no isinstance checks, no adapter implementations).
The SupportsIncremental docstring asserts in present tense that core uses incremental fetch conditionally, but this dispatch behavior does not exist anywhere in src/.
Two test cases reference SupportsIncremental to guard against its accidental adoption, but can be safely removed because SupportsLinks tests cover the same skip-path logic.
Removing SupportsIncremental requires amending ADR 0035 to correct the opt-in-capability count from three to two protocols and remove the symbol reference.
The reconciler's only active fetch path is full-scan (_build_snapshot in fetcher.py), making incremental fetch a zero-caller dead capability that contradicts documented behavior.
